newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil prisoners continue to hold nine hostage.
newsitem.headline: Brazil prisoners continue to hold nine hostage.

text.p: A group of Brazilian prisoners were continuing to hold nine people hostage in a rebellion that has already lasted two days, local news agency Agencia Estado said on Monday.

Eight prison workers and two ministers were taken hostage by 10 prisoners during afternoon visiting hours on Saturday at the prison in Vitoria da Conquista, Bahia state. One prison worker was later taken ill and released.
Local police officers said they could not comment on the situation. The telephone at the prison had been cut off by the prisoners, they added.
The detainees are demanding cars, revolvers and around $23,000 to make an escape attempt, Agencia Estado said.

They are armed with knives and are threatening to blow up the prison's administrative centre using cylinders of cooking gas. Local Globo television showed one of the prisoners holding a knife to the throat of a woman hostage.

In addition to the hostages, three guards and 50 detainees who did not take part in the rebellion are trapped in the prison's exercise area, unable to leave through the area occupied by the 10 prisoners and the hostages.
The group has had to spend two nights sleeping in the exercise area with temperatures falling to 54 degrees Fahrenheit (12 degrees Celsius), Agencia Estado said.
